categories_read.name: categories_read
categories_read.using: user_id is null or user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid

transactions_transfer_target_check.name: transactions_transfer_target_check
transactions_transfer_target_check.value:
case when "transactions"."type" = 'transfer'
        then num_nonnulls("transactions"."transfer_account_id", "transactions"."credit_card_invoice_id") = 1
        else "transactions"."transfer_account_id" is null and "transactions"."credit_card_invoice_id" is null end

insights_text_check.name: insights_text_check
insights_text_check.value: char_length("insights"."title") between 1 and 200 and char_length("insights"."body") between 1 and 1000
